description.value: Crispy Falafel is a Mediterranean restaurant founded in 2011 by Lebanese-Canadian entrepreneurs Mustapha and Adib, serving authentic falafel and Greek-inspired dishes made from fresh vegetables and homemade recipes. Situated on King George Boulevard in Surrey, it is the flagship location of a growing franchise brand with a second Lower Mainland outpost in White Rock. Cyclists on the King George corridor will find it a convenient stop for a health-focused Mediterranean meal.

address.value: 2408 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V4P 1H5, Canada
